title: ChatGPT Makes Personal Finance Tools Free for All US Free and Go Users
summary:
OpenAI has integrated credit score monitoring and spending dashboards into its AI assistant for the U.S. market. These personal finance tools are now available to users on the Free and Go account tiers, allowing them to link banking data via Plaid and Experian to track net worth, subscriptions, and bills. In September, the feature set was expanded to include stock watchlists, Coinbase support, and Voice integration.

The expansion of free access comes as competitor finance app Monarch Money reported crossing 1 million members and $100M in annual recurring revenue in October. Monarch, which focuses on budgeting and cash flow planning, also recently acquired MBI, formerly known as hmbradley.

One day after learning @monarch_money is at 1M+ users + $100M ARR

@ebloch shared that @ChatGPT made Finances FREE + in Sept they shipped credit score monitoring, stock watchlists, Voice, & Coinbase support

For ChatGPT Finances, you connect your accounts via @Plaid & get dashboards on spending, subscriptions, bills, net worth, portfolio allocation, + daily moves on ur holdings

Feels like it's already at parity with PFMs on the basics?

Have been having a version of this debate a lot recently re: the labs eating into the app layer --> the bear case for standalone PFMs is that every incremental new user gets more expensive to acquire when a free version lives inside ChatGPT

I still think there's room for both. Tech-forward users who love tinkering will prolly use ChatGPT for this stuff, but most consumers are passive and need to be acquired, educated & feel like they're working with a brand built for them

The labs will take a slice of PFM but I think the biggest consumer fintech cos will still be the ones whose whole purpose is serving that customer
